steps.text: Salt the steaks on both sides and leave them out of the fridge to lose their chill.
Get a heavy pan very hot with the oil, until it is just short of smoking.
Lay the steaks in and leave them alone so a crust has time to form.
Turn them once, then drop in the butter, garlic, and thyme.
Spoon the foaming butter over the steaks until the timer is up.
Move them to a warm plate and leave them completely alone.
Pour the pan butter over, grind on the pepper, and slice against the grain.
